state:
Goal `core-xml-node-and-1-more`: every `Core\Xml\Node` member has all its feature proofs, and
`bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Xml\Node'` says nothing owed, 0 failed.
Its attack found two bugs, both fixed in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs`: resolving a namespace
scanned every declaration in scope for each element (quadratic), and each element copied its URI
(a short document built a tree far past the memory limit). `Scope` now indexes prefixes and
shares one URI string per declaration; `elements_in_one_namespace_share_its_uri` pins the sharing.
`Core\Xml\Reader` (`read`, `depth`) owes everything, including its class card.
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/lib.rs` has an uncommitted change that is not this goal's (the `granting`
test helper canonicalizes grants). Leave it alone.

items.text: **`Core\Xml\Reader` class card, then `read`** — add its `ClassDoc` above the class's `CLASS` row and delete it from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5283`; `read` is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:2760`. A lead for its attack, found this session: each `read` costs time in proportion to the whole document, even with no namespaces — 100000 reads of `<e/>` under a root of 100000 plain attributes take about 7s, and 3 reads about 1s. Suspect `held.as_text()` on the document slot in `read` (`NvsStr::text_of`); not checked. `an_xml_element_answers_its_namespace_uri` already carries `covers: Core\Xml\Reader::read`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`

**`Core\Xml\Reader::depth`** — card `DEPTH_DOC` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:596`, member at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:2771`; owes about, examples, hostile, perf and two test cases. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`
